column1: # Translation action descriptions for the manual page and the web reference. Columns: action
column3: description
Begin a selection at the pointer. Repeated clicks within multiClickTime select by word and then by line. With the block parameter, or Meta held, the selection is rectangular.
Extend the selection in progress to the pointer, scrolling the history when the pointer leaves the window.
Finish the selection and publish it to the named selections and cut buffers, for example SELECT and CUT_BUFFER0.
Move the nearer end of the existing selection to the pointer and continue extending from there.
Paste the first named selection or cut buffer that yields text, trying UTF8_STRING before STRING.
Set selectToClipboard for this window.
Scroll the viewport back by count lines, halfpages, or pages. The m suffix means the binding is also a mouse action and is forwarded to an application that has enabled mouse reporting.
Scroll the viewport forward, with the same parameters as scroll-back.

Scroll the viewport up to the start of the previous shell prompt marked with OSC 133, count prompts back (default 1). A prompt in the visible live area needs no scrolling, and the alternate screen has no history to move through.
Scroll the viewport down to the start of the next OSC 133 prompt, with the same parameter as previous-prompt.
Deliver the key to the application through the normal input path instead of running a local action; binding it to a gesture such as Ctrl Shift <KeyPress> Up restores xterm's key delivery.
Same as insert-seven-bit; Revenant encodes the key from the current keyboard modes rather than from this choice.

Send the output of the most recently completed shell command, found through its OSC 133 marks, to the pipeCommandOutput command's standard input, run in the last OSC 7 directory when one is known. Does nothing when that resource is unset or the command wrote nothing.
Switch to the next larger configured font slot.
Switch to the next smaller configured font slot.
Switch between the Xft and bitmap renderers.
Change forceBoxChars: draw box and block characters from the cell geometry instead of the font.
Post the named popup menu: mainMenu, vtMenu, or fontMenu.
Report the button press to an application that has enabled mouse reporting; otherwise do nothing.
Report pointer motion to an application that has enabled mouse reporting.
If the cell under the pointer carries an OSC 8 hyperlink or visible HTTP(S) URL, arm it so that the release opens it with xdg-open(1); otherwise behave as select-start.
Write a snapshot of collected font routing decisions to standard error. Requires reportFontRouting.
